input: Set a screen time limit on my phone

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: The steps to set screen time limits differ entirely between iOS and Android, so the phone's operating system determines the exact instructions.
The limit could apply to the whole phone overall, specific apps (e.g. social media), or certain app categories — this changes what gets restricted.
The target daily limit (e.g. 1 hour, 2 hours) is the core parameter that needs to be configured in the settings.
If this is for a child, parental controls or Family Link may be involved; if for themselves, the approach and enforcement method differ.
Some people want a hard block when the limit is hit; others prefer just a warning notification — this determines which setting to choose.
Whether the limit should apply all day or only during specific time windows (e.g. after 9 PM, during work hours) changes how the schedule is configured.
Knowing what the user is trying to achieve (better sleep, more focus, less social media) helps prioritise which features or apps to target first.

gold.taskTitle: Set a screen time limit on my phone
gold.taskDescription: The user wants to configure screen time restrictions on their phone to limit how long they spend on it.

questions.title: What phone do you have — iPhone or Android?
questions.description: Identifies the operating system so the correct step-by-step instructions (Screen Time on iOS vs. Digital Wellbeing on Android) can be provided.

questions.title: Limit the whole phone or specific apps only?
questions.description: Determines whether a total daily usage cap is needed or whether limits should be set on individual apps or app categories like social media or games.

questions.title: How many hours per day is your target limit?
questions.description: Establishes the actual time value to enter into the screen time settings.

questions.title: Is this limit for yourself or for a child?
questions.description: Determines whether standard personal screen time settings are used or whether parental control tools like Family Sharing or Google Family Link need to be set up.

questions.title: Should the phone hard-block you or just send a warning?
questions.description: Clarifies whether the user wants usage fully blocked when the limit is reached or simply a nudge notification to be aware they have hit their goal.

questions.title: Should the limit apply all day or specific hours only?
questions.description: Determines whether a simple daily cap suffices or whether a scheduled downtime window (e.g. evenings, work hours) also needs to be configured.

questions.title: What habit or problem is this screen time limit solving?
questions.description: Understanding the underlying goal — better sleep, focus, reducing social media — helps prioritise which apps or features to restrict first for maximum impact.
